description: This PHP source file defines the 'AuthCodeEntity' class, which implements the 'AuthCodeEntityInterface' for OAuth2 authorization code management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods for handling redirect URIs, identifiers, expiry times, user identifiers, client associations, and scopes, utilizing traits for date-time and OAuth server functionalities.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Implementation of OAuth2 AuthCodeEntityInterface for managing OAuth authorization codes, with properties for redirect URI, identifier, expiry, user ID, client, and scopes, and associated methods for accessing and mutating these properties.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the auth code, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time, overriding with a UTC time calculated from current time plus TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with the auth code, or null if not set.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the user identifier associated with the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Associates a client entity with the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns an array of all scopes associated with the auth code.
